Coordinated with QA and dev teams through Jira to close high-severity defects faster.

Created and maintained JUnit-based integration tests and Selenium-driven functional suites for core workflows, increasing release confidence. Automated API validations and regression probes using Postman and integrated results into Jira for traceability. Contributed to Test Automation standards and CI job definitions.
